newsitem.title: UK: UK's Brown wants stability, low inflation.
newsitem.headline: UK's Brown wants stability, low inflation.

text.p: British Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown said on Wednesday he wanted the country to have a stable economic environment with low inflation.
Asked about market speculation that interest rates would rise again soon, Brown said: "We've got to keep inflation down. I want us to plan for the long term."
Brown ceded control of interest rates to the Bank of England last week.
He said it was vital for Britain to escape from the former cycle of boom and bust. "I want stability."
